lede: Thanksgiving week lands squarely on this stretch of the calendar, and the valley is leaning into it — Turkey Trot on Thursday morning, an Outlaw Thanksgiving at Alloy Kitchen, live music at Mountain Lodge, and Will Ski 4 Food on Saturday to kick off the holiday weekend right. On the government side, the Open Space Commission, the Board of County Commissioners, and the Mountain Village Metro District all have meetings on the books, but none have posted agendas yet, so there's nothing to weigh in on this week.
